question: For each commodity, which single part had the worst PPM over the last 12 months of the window? The window ends August 2026.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.commodity)
    s.commodity,
    p.part_id,
    p.part_name,
    COALESCE(d.total_defects, 0) * 1000000.0 / v.total_volume AS ppm
FROM spike.parts p
JOIN spike.suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
JOIN (
    SELECT part_id, SUM(units_produced) AS total_volume
    FROM spike.production_volume
    WHERE month >= '2025-09-01' AND month < '2026-09-01'
    GROUP BY part_id
) v ON p.part_id = v.part_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT part_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_defects
    FROM spike.defects
    WHERE detected_date >= '2025-09-01' AND detected_date < '2026-09-01'
    GROUP BY part_id
) d ON p.part_id = d.part_id
ORDER BY s.commodity, COALESCE(d.total_defects, 0) * 1000000.0 / v.total_volume DESC;

question: Which parts had a defect PPM above their own supplier's average PPM over the full window?
sql:
WITH defect_totals AS (
    SELECT part_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_defects
    FROM spike.defects
    GROUP BY part_id
),
production_totals AS (
    SELECT part_id, SUM(units_produced) AS total_units
    FROM spike.production_volume
    GROUP BY part_id
),
part_ppms AS (
    SELECT 
        p.part_id,
        p.part_name,
        p.supplier_id,
        (COALESCE(d.total_defects, 0)::numeric / pt.total_units) * 1000000 AS ppm
    FROM spike.parts p
    JOIN production_totals pt ON p.part_id = pt.part_id
    LEFT JOIN defect_totals d ON p.part_id = d.part_id
),
supplier_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        part_id,
        part_name,
        ppm,
        AVG(ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id) AS avg_supplier_ppm
    FROM part_ppms
)
SELECT part_id, part_name
FROM supplier_stats
WHERE ppm > avg_supplier_ppm;
